en.html:
花枝 Shishiku!? ...Didi!
Kanae Gh...!
獅子吼 Three minutes and fifty seconds I have been following behind you. All that time, and you noticed nothing, fool...?
獅子吼 That evil eye of yours remains very selective. What ought to be seen, that only it cannot see. Not a trace of the greater cause, not a trace of loyalty. Unnecessary things, meanwhile, it sees very nicely...
獅子吼 A vulgar little eye, fit for a vulgar little mind! You belong to the Ootori line, however unworthily. Why, then, have you no sovereign's eye?
Kanae ...Kh. A sovereign's... eye?
Kanae With that, perhaps... I could have avoided being caught by a freak attacking from the wall, with movements to put a newt to shame? How useful that would have been...!
獅子吼 Keep talking. I merely measured the distance from which one move would reach you.
獅子吼 Neither the occasion nor the opponent was deserving of a warrior's courtesies...!
Kanae Oh... in that case. Why not finish killing me quickly, then...?
獅子吼 Believe me, sending you to the next world cannot happen soon enough. But—
獅子吼 This mouth of yours uttered something I cannot leave unanswered.
Kanae ...Did it, now...?
獅子吼 Not your little revenge game. Let us be clear on that. You want my life? Haan, keep trying. As much as you like...
獅子吼 Keep trying, so long as you feel no shame that you inherit the blood of Ootori's main line and still see nothing beyond your own private revenge! You think a small creature like that will get my head!?

花枝 「獅子吼!? 　……姉さん！」
香奈枝 「ぐ……！」
獅子吼 「三分と五〇秒前から背後に従ついていたわ。 　気付かなかったのか間抜けめ……」
獅子吼 「貴様の邪眼は相変わらず、見るべきものに 限って見えんらしいな。 　大義も信義も、いっかな宿さん。そのくせ 余計なものはよく映す……」
獅子吼 「愚にもつかぬ下衆の眼だ！ 　卑しくも大鳥の家系に連なる者が、何ゆえ 王者の眼を持たん！」
香奈枝 「……っ。 　王者の……眼？」
香奈枝 「それがあれば……イモリも顔負けの動きで 壁から・・・襲ってくる変態に捕まらなくて済んだ のかしら？ 　重宝だこと……ッ」
獅子吼 「抜かせ。 　貴様に一手で届く間合を計っただけの事だ」
獅子吼 「武人の作法を守るべき時でも相手でもなか ろうしな……！」
香奈枝 「あら……なら。 　どうして、さっさと殺してしまわないのか、 しら……？」
獅子吼 「俺とて一刻も早く貴様を冥途につかせたい。 　が――」
獅子吼 「この口が、聞き捨てならぬ事をほざいた」
香奈枝 「……さぁ……？」
獅子吼 「言っておくが、貴様の仇討ごっこの事では ない。 　俺の命を狙う？　ああ、好きなだけ狙うが いい……」
獅子吼 「大鳥嫡流の血を享うけながら、己一身の復讐 しか眼に入らぬ、その狭量を恥じぬかぎりは いつまでもな！ 　そんな小人に俺が首をやると思うか!!」

en.html:
Kanae ............
獅子吼 Nor do Lady Hanae's words trouble me... To use me for Yamato and discard me afterwards—that is her intention, I hear. If anything, I was relieved.
獅子吼 That much ambition, at least, is required of someone to whom I, Shishiku, might consent to bow.
花枝 ...
獅子吼 Her eyes see a good deal further than yours! Beyond the end of her own nose, for a start. For discarding you and retaining Lady Hanae, the previous lord deserves credit. In that one matter only.
獅子吼 Not nearly enough credit to cancel the crime of rebelling against the lord before him...
Kanae ...Kh... Then... what is it...?
獅子吼 What you said before that. ...Do you know something about Lord Yuhi's murder in Kamakura?
Kanae ............
獅子吼 I had thought it your doing. Kill the rightful successor to protect your younger sister's position... With your shallow cleverness, quite possible.
獅子吼 That suspicion still stands. But... for the moment, I shall give your account a hearing.
花枝 ...
獅子吼 Speak, Kanae. What do you know?
Kanae You are asking... the wrong person, are you not? For such things, there is the police...
獅子吼 Kamakura City Police? They have not even announced the incident. Supposedly this is a measure for the investigation... A strange arrangement. There is a smell to it.
獅子吼 I meant to squeeze an answer out of them in due course. ...But if I make you talk now, that trouble can be saved, no?
獅子吼 No evasion, you vixen.
